components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Full-width pill CTA. One per screen. Used for start session, complete workout.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; background: #7DD3FC; color: #0A0A0B; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px -4px rgba(125,211,252,0.4); transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: #A5E0FB; } .ds-btn-cta:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-cta:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(212,168,83,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Primary action within a content area. White fill, near-black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: #F5F5F4; color: #0A0A0B; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.4); transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(0.97); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-btn-default:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(212,168,83,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary and destructive actions. Low visual weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; background: transparent; color: #F5F5F4; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(212,168,83,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Session Chip
components.description: Uppercase label chip for session type tags and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #F5F5F4; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Session Type Chip — Threshold
components.description: Session chip colored by session type. Example: threshold variant.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; color: #F5F5F4; font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-chip-threshold { background: rgba(212,168,83,0.12); color: #D4A853; }

components.name: Floating Nav
components.description: Glass pill navigation. Bottom-fixed on mobile, top-center on desktop.
components.css: .ds-floating-nav { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 50; padding: 8px; background: rgba(10,10,11,0.70); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-nav-list { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: rgba(125,211,252,0.12); } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: rgba(245,245,244,0.50); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-icon { color: #7DD3FC; } .ds-nav-label { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(245,245,244,0.70); overflow: hidden; max-width: 0; opacity: 0; transition: max-width 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-label { color: #7DD3FC; max-width: 80px; opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-label--hidden { max-width: 0; opacity: 0; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(212,168,83,0.5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hero Numeric Display
components.description: Large monospace metric display. Used for HR, pace, distance on session screens.
components.css: .ds-num-block { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; } .ds-num-hero { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace; font-size: 3.5rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; color: #F5F5F4; } .ds-num-unit { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(245,245,244,0.50); }

components.css: .ds-session-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-left: 3px solid #D4A853; padding: 16px 0 16px 12px; } .ds-session-row--easy { border-left-color: #8B9E8B; } .ds-session-row--threshold { border-left-color: #D4A853; } .ds-session-row--long { border-left-color: #7B8EC2; } .ds-session-row--vo2max { border-left-color: #C25B5B; } .ds-session-row--strength { border-left-color: #8A8A8E; } .ds-session-row-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-session-row-title { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #F5F5F4; } .ds-session-row-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-num-inline { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SF Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: rgba(245,245,244,0.70); } .ds-session-sep { color: rgba(245,245,244,0.35); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-chip-sm { display: inline-flex; padding: 1px 6px; background: rgba(212,168,83,0.12); color: #D4A853; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-rule { height: 1px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border: none; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Project Ares is designed like a periodized training plan made visible: structured, measured, and free of noise. Every screen has a single primary job — check in, log, review — and the interface enforces that discipline through generous negative space, hard divider lines instead of cards, and monospace numerals that dominate the visual hierarchy.

The system rejects the default posture of fitness software: no dashboard grids stacked with stats, no gradient fills that pulse with motivation, no neon accents that announce themselves. Information earns its right to be on screen.

The Athletic Topographic direction uses session-type colors as its only categorical accent vocabulary. These colors do not decorate — they encode. Amber means threshold. Brick red means VO2max. They are never used for decoration or brand expression.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with tonal surface layering; no shadows on content
Dual typography: Geist sans for prose and labels, Geist Mono for all numeric output
Seven session-type colors as the only categorical encoding vocabulary
Horizontal rule dividers as the primary structural tool, not cards
Glass pill floating navigation — the single purposeful glassmorphism exception
Mobile-first layout with full iOS safe-area awareness

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber (#D4A853) is the only color used outside the session-type categorical vocabulary. It appears on 5% or less of any given screen. Introducing a new accent color for any reason is prohibited.

rules.name: The Data Encoding Rule
rules.body: Session-type colors exist to identify session types. They do not decorate callouts, alerts, or any UI element that is not literally identifying a training session type.

rules.name: The Mono Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every numeric value in the interface uses Geist Mono with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. No exceptions. A number rendered in Geist sans is always a mistake.

rules.name: The Scale Contract
rules.body: Headline (1.25rem) to Body (0.875rem) is a 1.43× ratio. Do not introduce sizes that compress this below 1.2×. Flat typographic scales remove hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If you are reaching for box-shadow on any component other than FloatingNav or PrimaryButton, stop. Use a border or a surface color step instead.

dos: Do leave generous vertical space between sections — breathing room is functional, not wasted.
Do use horizontal rule dividers (.rule, 1px, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) as the default structural separator.
Do render all numeric values in Geist Mono with tabular-nums.
Do use session-type colors strictly to identify session types.
Do design for 390px first. Desktop is additive.
Do keep PrimaryButton to one per screen.
Do use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for state transitions.
donts: Don't use neon on dark backgrounds — the neon-fitness-app aesthetic (Whoop, Mirror) is the primary anti-reference.
Don't replicate Garmin Connect's data density. One metric wins; others support.
Don't replicate TrainingPeaks' clinical grey grid.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). All text is a single solid foreground color.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. The FloatingNav pill is the only blur in the system.
Don't use the hero-metric SaaS dashboard template.
Don't add a new accent color outside the defined vocabulary.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) outside of the session-stripe component.
